answer_1.quote: Pre-trained language models have achieved promising results in abstractive text summarization ... We conduct our study on two benchmark summarization datasets.

answer_2.quote: Table 1: ROUGE-1/2/L scores for model reproduction on CNN/DM and XSum datasets. ... Pegasus and BART generally obtain the highest ROUGE scores.

answer_4.quote: Crowdsourcing is done via MTurk. ... Best-Worst Scaling (BWS) is a type of ranking-oriented evaluation that requires annotators to specify only the best and the worst example in a set of summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to label the most factually consistent summary and the least factually consistent summary (or rate each summary on a Likert scale).
